/**
 * @name Dangerous function calls in pyasn1_modules
 * @description Finding eval, exec, pickle, subprocess, and other dangerous functions
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/dangerous-calls
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // Code execution
    call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember(["eval", "exec", "compile"]).getACall() or
    call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec", "compile"]).getACall() or
    
    // Unsafe deserialization
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall() or
    
    // Command execution
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "popen2", "popen3", "popen4"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "Popen", "run", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() or
    
    // File operations that could be dangerous with user input
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["remove", "unlink", "rmdir", "mkdir", "makedirs", "chmod", "chown"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shutil").getMember(["rmtree", "copy", "move"]).getACall() or
    
    // Network operations
    call = API::moduleImport("socket").getMember(["create_connection", "connect", "bind", "listen"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember(["urlopen", "request"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib2").getMember(["urlopen", "Request"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially dangerous function call that could lead to security vulnerabilities if used with untrusted input."
findings.hypothesis: Looking for dangerous function calls like eval, exec, pickle, subprocess, os.system, etc. that could lead to code injection, command injection, or unsafe deserialization
